note: P2-D0 corrects defects that code review found in the P2-C result. The P2-C evidence trees are byte-identical and are NOT regenerated; the corrections below are recorded forward-only.

errata.p2cClaim: the P2-C attributed Preview admits only source-qualified, current execution evidence
errata.defect: the qualifier rechecks currentness BEFORE returning, but the adapter reads the DSH page afterwards with no second relevant-basis check, so a conflict committed during Event Read is still admitted (F3)
errata.correction: a bounded post-Event-Read relevant-basis recheck, yielding RACED or an unresolved outcome rather than a stale admission

errata.p2cClaim: mixed Invocation states are handled without misleading default selection
errata.defect: selectInvocation returns SELECTED_UNIQUE for one qualified invocation without consulting the unresolved states of the others (F2)
errata.correction: automatic unique selection only when the whole relevant Invocation set justifies it; the output states the remaining unresolved invocations

errata.p2cClaim: Invocation windows close from actual supported Parent lifecycle evidence
errata.defect: the delegation finalizes every invocation of the Attempt with the single closeReason INVOCATION_RETURNED, so a timeout/abort finalizes an unclosed window and one Job closes another (F5, F6)
errata.correction: Invocation-scoped finalization from real Parent lifecycle evidence; a timeout/abort before confirmed closure remains incomplete

errata.p2cClaim: the attributed Preview presents Canonical Work and Project Evolution context
errata.defect: the adapter supplies resultRefs [], verificationState NOT_OBSERVED_BY_P2C, reworkState NONE and an empty project-evolution projection, replacing facts the V0 composition can establish (F13)
errata.correction: reuse the existing V0/T0 helpers (canonicalFactsOf, buildRelationContext, projectEvolutionOf, composeTrajectoryInputs) rather than placeholders

errata.defect: the composition accepts databasePath ':memory:' and the qualifier still sets verification VERIFIED with a durableBindingRef, so an in-memory store yields a durable-looking result (F9)
errata.correction: an explicit ephemeral qualification distinct from durable qualification; an ephemeral record cannot claim cold-recoverable durability

errata.p2cClaim: the mounted DSH Reader is disposed by installed.dispose()
errata.defect: OwnedResource.close is synchronous and the reader async close is voided, so disposal does not wait for the Cordis fiber (F10)
errata.correction: an additive void | Promise<void> close contract with sequential awaiting, preserving the existing synchronous-resource behavior

errata.p2cClaim: a record cannot become first-party-verified by declaring a label
errata.defect: an expert-supplied Worker Port replaces the derived port while the trusted basis and FIRST_PARTY_DSH_HOST kind still come from workWorkerBin, so a stub can borrow first-party authority (F11)
errata.correction: require source-basis alignment between the port and the basis, or conservatively mark the producer unqualified

errata.p2cClaim: the P2-A identity observation path preserves what the Parent observed
errata.defect: the tracker rebuilds one observation whose dshSessionId is always the first, and the recorder persists only that field, so A/B/C collapse to {A} (F1)
errata.correction: every distinct valid IPC Session identity report reaches durable ingestion as an immutable candidate

errata.p2cClaim: the extended installed Trajectory capability is a supported public surface
errata.defect: Deployment.installed is typed InstalledPalimpsest while the runtime carries trajectory, so the capability is not statically reachable (F18)
errata.correction: the narrowest supported contract extraction so the public type describes the runtime capability
